_what_this_is: Verification of a list of 20 claimed cardiology meta-analyses, each said to carry a high-leverage analytical defect. THIS IS VERIFICATION, NOT ANALYSIS. No re-analysis was started.

_evidence_grades.MEASURED: established by a command recorded in this file, against a free source
_evidence_grades.INFERRED: derived from a MEASURED fact by stated reasoning
_evidence_grades.CLAIMED: asserted by the source list and NOT established here

_free_sources_only: PubMed E-utilities, Europe PMC REST, the journal's own page. Standing scope rule.
_procedure: Per candidate, stop at the first failure: (1) does the paper exist -- resolve journal/year/DOI/title, never match on title alone; (2) is it open access; (3) does the claimed defect exist in the paper's own bytes, quoted with a locator; (4) does the claimed critique-letter exist; (5) only then, is it reconstructible.

_headline._note: 0 of 1 assessed candidates survived step 3, and the reason is RETRIEVAL, not refutation. See _the_finding.

_the_finding: The single candidate I could assess EXISTS and is OPENLY LICENSED (cc by-nc-nd) yet its full text is NOT RETRIEVABLE from any free source: no PMC record, no Europe PMC full text, and HTTP 403 from both jacc.org and sciencedirect.com. So the claimed defect can be neither confirmed nor refuted. ⛔ THIS IS THE SAME WALL THAT ENDED THE COCHRANE COMPARISON, in a different journal: we cannot read the included-study list or the results text, so a claim about them is unscoreable. If the remaining 19 are similarly recent Elsevier/JACC-family papers, verification will hit the same wall and the list's strategic value collapses -- not because the claims are false, but because they are UNCHECKABLE by us. That is worth establishing before any re-analysis is planned.
_licence_is_not_retrieval: cc by-nc-nd is a statement about the paper's TERMS. isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, inPMC=N, pmcid=null, hasPDF=N are statements about what we can OBTAIN. They are different facts and this file never collapses them. 'We could not get the paper' is NOT 'the paper lacks the number'.

claimed_defect.value: The text reports OR 0.91 (0.72-1.16), P=.44 and the figure reports OR 0.59 (0.36-0.96), P=.03 FOR THE SAME OUTCOME -- a document that contradicts itself.
claimed_defect.why_it_was_checked_first: If true it is a known-answer control sitting inside the document: a self-contradiction can be checked without reconstructing anything.

step1_exists.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Exposure During Pregnancy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes.
commands: esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=(GLP-1 OR glucagon-like) AND pregnan* AND ("JACC"[Journal] OR "JACC. Advances"[Journal])  -> count=1, id 41925658
step1_exists.identity_note: Identity confirmed on journal + year + DOI + title TOGETHER, and the DOI independently resolves to an Elsevier PII. Not matched on title alone.
step1_exists.⛔_a_near_miss_recorded: Four OTHER real 2026 GLP-1-in-pregnancy meta-analyses exist -- PMIDs 42536323 (Endocrine), 42307450 (Clinical Obesity), 42447044 (Endocrine Connections), 42061782 (AJOG). Matching on topic alone would have resolved to a REAL BUT DIFFERENT PAPER, which is the dangerous failure mode here.
step1_exists.⛔_my_own_query_artefact: The search '"JACC. Advances"[Journal] AND meta-analysis[pt] AND 2026[dp]' returned COUNT=0, because this paper is indexed with PublicationType 'Journal Article' only and is NOT tagged Meta-Analysis. That zero was a REACH ARTEFACT OF MY QUERY, not evidence of absence. Had I stopped there I would have wrongly reported the paper as nonexistent.

step3_defect_in_the_paper_s_own_bytes.grade: MEASURED (about our access) / the defect itself remains CLAIMED
step3_defect_in_the_paper_s_own_bytes.⛔_not_a_refutation: The claimed text-versus-figure contradiction is NEITHER CONFIRMED NOR REFUTED. We could not obtain the bytes. Reporting this as 'the defect is absent' would be exactly the error of treating a failed retrieval as a fact about the paper.
step3_defect_in_the_paper_s_own_bytes.what_would_settle_it: One retrieval of the full text or of Figure/Table carrying the outcome in question, from any route the scope rule permits. A single page would do it: the claim is a self-contradiction, so it needs no reconstruction and no comparator.

step4_critique_letter.reason: step 3 did not pass; the procedure stops at the first failure

candidates.overall: EXISTS, OPENLY LICENSED, NOT RETRIEVABLE. Defect unverified and NOT refuted.

candidates_2_to_20.⛔_why_there_are_no_rows: The list itself was described but not included in the instruction I received. I have candidate #1's details only. I will not create rows for candidates I have not been given, and I will not infer their journals, DOIs or claimed defects -- a fabricated row in a verification file is worse than an absent one, because it is indistinguishable from a checked one.
candidates_2_to_20.what_I_need: The 20 rows as supplied: for each, the claimed title, journal, year, DOI if given, the claimed defect, and whether a critique letter is claimed.

_what_was_NOT_done: No re-analysis was started. Verification only, as instructed.
No extraction rule, no pooling, no comparison against our corpus.
No candidate was scored, and the frozen comparator protocol was not touched.
